withheld_reason: The product's incidence raster is not an incidence angle: 80.53 % of its values over the valid mask are below the label's own look angle of 19.9979 deg, which is geometrically impossible on a convex body; its median pixel-to-pixel step is 35x the geometric ramp; and it correlates with DEM slope at -0.0006, so it is not a local incidence either. The field cannot be re-derived from the label, which carries no ephemeris, to the accuracy a 20 deg threshold needs. The criterion is withheld rather than estimated.

withdrawn_figures.claim: 'this pass was flown at a look angle of 19.998 deg, below the Bragg floor for the entire scene' — withdrawn; the label gives the same value for look angle and incidence angle, which cannot both be true, and the raster settles neither
